responsibility: Declares the derive expander used for both builtin #[derive(Ord)] and #[derive(PartialOrd)] in gcc/rust/expand. The DeriveOrd class extends the generic DeriveVisitor with an Ordering mode selector, helper APIs for building cmp/partial_cmp calls, equal-pattern and nested-match structures, the synthesized comparison method and enclosing trait impl, and the visit hooks for structs, tuple structs, enums, and unions that drive comparison-trait AST generation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the DeriveOrd class and its API for shared Ord/PartialOrd expansion, while rust-derive-ord.cc defines the actual AST-construction algorithms, comparison-match generation, and visit-method behavior.
